content.rendered: Hawks View is excited to welcome our students and families from 4-6pm on Monday, August 28th. If students have their supplies, they may bring them this evening, but it is certainly not a requirement. It’s an opportunity to meet your teacher (students will be notified of teacher assignments by 3:30pm on Friday 8/25) and see friends. Kona Ice will be on site for purchase as will HV apparel from PAC. Additionally, Hawks View is the recipient of “Make a Difference Monday” at Langers. All proceeds from bowling on the 28th go directly to our school! It should be a great afternoon/evening!
